alex: quick question about streaming deltas + function/tool-call shapes. i ran into an incompat where interim deltas show function_call.arguments as a stringified JSON, but final payload returns arguments as an object. is that the intended contract?

alex: example:
```
# stream delta chunks
{
  "type": "delta",
  "function_call": {
    "name": "get_user",
    "arguments": "{\"id\":\"123\"}"
  }
}
...
# final non-streamed message
{
  "type": "response",
  "function_call": {
    "name": "get_user",
    "arguments": { "id": "123" }
  }
}
```

alex: the runtime currently reconstructs the arguments by parsing the concatenated token stream — that works but it feels like the public contract is fuzzy. should clients expect stringified args during streaming always, or should we switch to emitting partial objects (which is painful)? :thinking:

maria: we stringify to avoid invalid JSON mid-stream. parsing partial tokens into objects is brittle. the contract we intended: deltas MAY contain stringified arguments while final response MUST be structured object. we probably need to call that out in the spec explicitly. cc @devon

devon: okay — couple follow-ups: 1) what about function_call vs tool_call keys? some runtimes emit "tool_call" for external tool chunks. we should normalize in docs. 2) do we want an explicit flag on deltas (eg `is_partial: true`) so clients can rely on shape instead of heuristics?

samir: +1 on `is_partial`. Another practical option: add `arguments_encoding: "stringified-json"` on deltas. both options are backwards-compatible (new field only). liking `is_partial` since it's minimal. also consider: streaming embeddings/kv caching also use partial strings so common pattern makes sense.

julie: i've opened a tiny spec PR to clarify shapes and add examples + tests: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/789 — requests reviewers from eng-runtime and eng-platform. could reviewers skim the diffs? i added both the delta example and a small test case that validates runtime output shapes.

ci-bot: GitHub CI | infra#789 — unit checks: failed on fmt, tests: 2 failed. see CI logs. :exclamation:

alex: thanks — i'll fix fmt/test in runtime and add a test that verifies we add `is_partial` on intermediate deltas. also will add a short note in the API changelog section for backward-compat concerns.

maria: once runtime patch is in, i'll update docs snippets and add a short migration note for SDKs.

devon: rough compatibility matrix for the PR description might help: list consumers + whether they accept string vs object. i can draft one.

alex: sweet. tagging this thread for async follow-up. will ping when PR green. :thumbsup:
